entry.title: Introducing The AzurPoly Dassault Rafale
entry.summary: Experience the first officially licensed Dassault Aviation Rafale C* for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024!Developed by AzurPoly in cooperation with JFEXP, this detailed rendition brings one of France’s most advanced aircraft to the simulator with a high level of care, immersion and functionality.
